description: Retrieval methods compared on SQuAD and ConditionalQA: dense (bge-m3), sparse (BM25) and hybrid (reciprocal rank fusion of the two), all three on the same indexes. The other stages are at the README's baseline: fixed_token chunking, its max_tokens and overlap swept so that compare.py reports each alternative at its best, no augmentation, bge-m3, dense retrieval, no reranking. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/retrieval_eval_squad_conditionalqa.json
